subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways support separately opt-in Tailscale identity authentication as a permanent gateway authorization boundary?
rationale: The implementation can preserve least privilege and still require a human policy choice about trusting tailnet identity and ACL administration for gateway access.

options.title: Approve explicit identity trust
options.body: Support the separate opt-in setting after current-head proof confirms the constrained identity lookup, root-owned lifecycle, rollback, and preserved token/device flows.

options.title: Ship transport-only Serve
options.body: Provide private WSS connectivity but always require OpenClaw token or device authentication.

options.title: Defer Tailscale provisioning
options.body: Pause the core feature until long-term ownership and authorization expectations are established.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit identity trust
recommendation.body: Support the separate opt-in setting after current-head proof confirms the constrained identity lookup, root-owned lifecycle, rollback, and preserved token/device flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with ownership of the generated gateway onboarding and setup contract that this feature extends.
